You can repair existing machines or buy and invest in new. Please note that existing machines have no keys for coin box so they will need to be replaced. Can be run unattended or attended. Lots of potential especially at this price. Has room/office for wash & fold if new buyer wants to add this service. Landlord will do a new 10 year lease. Great Rent starting at $1200 for 1,000 sq ft. Great opportunity to revitalize this laundromat and increase services. $35,000 FIRM No Offers less than this will be accepted.

description: Great starter laundromat that has been in place for over 25 years. Rent is 3500 for approx. 1000 sq ft. Has office and bathroom. Store is run mostly unattended and has auto lock doors and lights. It is only attended 28 hours a week for 4 days and 7 hours each day. Store is currently at breakeven with partially attended model but showing profits of $18,000 if convert to unattended as wash & fold has low volume since the store is 75% unattended. Value of this store is in infrastructure (gas, electric & plumbing). Great opportunity for retool. Barely doing any wash & fold since store is only staffed 28 hours a week. Wash & Fold would be ideal for this area but you would need to expand hours. Offering PUD through Door Dash & Uber through one of the POS Systems would be ideal too. Machine prices are very low and room to increase. Busy plaza located off main road. 18 Dryers & 16 washers ranging from 15-25 years old. Great entry level laundromat with potential to build wash & fold revenue. $7

description: This store is in a PERFECT location. It is surrounded by 2-3 family homes with large parking lot in a well appointed plaza. title: Oops, we've got a problem...
description: Oops, we've got a problem... This website requires cookies to function properly.  Cookies allow us to keep track of the homes you click on and the searches you perform.  This is done to make your use of this site more enjoyable and successful.  We DO NOT share your information in any way.  Your information remains private and secure. What is a Cookie? A cookie is a small piece of data that a website stores in your browser to remember information about you between visits. It helps the site recognize your device and keep track of things like whether you’re logged in, your preferences, or items you’ve viewed, so you don’t have to start over each time you load a page. Cookies don’t run programs or access your computer—they simply store information that the website can read later to make your experience faster and more personalized. How to Turn Cookies ON using Chrome Open Chrome. Click the three dots (⋮) in the upper-right corner. Click Settings. In the left menu, click Privacy and security. Click Third-party cookies. Select Allow third-party cookies. How to Turn Cookies ON using Safari Open Safari. Click Safari in the top menu bar. Click Settings (or Preferences, depending on macOS version). Click the Privacy tab. Make sure “Block all cookies” is unchecked. How to Turn Cookies ON using Microsoft Edge Open Microsoft Edge. Click the three dots (⋯) in the upper-right corner. Click Settings. Click Privacy, search, and services in the left menu. Scroll down and click Cookies and site permissions. Click Manage and delete cookies and site data. Make sure “Allow sites to save and read cookie data (recommended)” is turned On. Make sure “Block all cookies” is turned Off. How to Turn Cookies ON using Firefox Open Firefox. Click the menu button (☰) in the upper-right corner. Click Settings. Click Privacy & Security in the left menu. Under Enhanced Tracking Protection, select Standard.

Business: Duty of a firm's directors and officers to act prudently in evaluating associated risks in all transactions. Investing: Duty of the investor to gather necessary information on actual or potential risks involved in an investment. Negotiating: Duty of each party to confirm each other's expectations and understandings, and to independently verify the abilities of the other to fulfill the conditions and requirements of the agreement. What does this mean to you as a business owner looking to sell your business? This means you need to take a close look at your business as if you were a buyer. Whether your business is a thriving multi-million dollar business or a small restaurant buyers are always weary of what lurks in the shadows.  This means you need to clear up any potential issues or questions BEFORE they arise which can take a year or more depending on your business type and size. It is never too soon to start the process of selling your business by contacting a business broker to guide you through the process of positioning your business for sale. title: American Property Group Successfully Sells Prominent Stand-Alone Restaurant in Bradenton, FL
description: American Property Group Successfully Sells Prominent Stand-Alone Restaurant in Bradenton, FL Jun 18 Written By APG Columnist American Property Group of Sarasota, Inc. is thrilled to announce the successful sale of the stand-alone restaurant property located at 1720 Cortez Rd W, Bradenton, FL. Previously home to Demetrios' Pizza House, this prime piece of real estate sold for an impressive $2,442,120, equating to $644 per square foot. Situated on one of the busiest roads in Manatee County, this outstanding location boasts daily traffic counts of 54,000 vehicles, making it an ideal spot for any business seeking high visibility and accessibility. The property features an abundance of parking, with approximately 42 parking spots, translating to an exceptional 10.54 parking spaces per 1,000 square feet. This ample parking capacity is a rare find and adds significant value to the site. The building has a rich history as a beloved local pizza restaurant, serving the community for many years. Its legacy, combined with its prime location and robust infrastructure, made it a highly sought-after property in the commercial real estate market. Adam Doak, a leading agent with American Property Group of Sarasota, Inc., managed the listing and sale of the property. His expertise and dedication were instrumental in securing a successful transaction, highlighting the commitment of American Property Group to deliver exceptional service and results to its clients. "We are proud to have facilitated the sale of this remarkable property," said Adam Doak. "The high traffic location and ample parking make it a standout opportunity for the new owners. We are confident that this site will continue to thrive and serve the community well." American Property Group of Sarasota, Inc. continues to demonstrate its strength and expertise in the commercial real estate market, offering unparalleled service and dedication to its clients.
